name: sales
description: Practical sales workflows for sellers. Prepare for meetings, follow up after calls, prioritize accounts, analyze signals, plan deals, build business cases, review forecasts, find customer evidence, coach reps, enrich data, and work from CRM context.

interface.longDescription:
Bring customer context into the work that moves deals forward. Prepare for customer meetings, follow up after calls, understand account signals, prioritize accounts, plan active deals, build business cases and competitive briefs, review forecasts, find customer quotes and internal experts, coach reps from calls, and enrich company and contact data.

Start with CRM details, calendar events, call notes, docs, messages, uploaded files, account lists, or pasted context. Connect tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Outreach, Clay, Rox, and Actively to bring scattered context together and turn the available evidence into practical next steps.
defaultPrompt: Prepare me for my next important customer meeting. Give me the context, likely blockers, and questions I should ask.
Which accounts should I focus on this week? Rank them, explain why, and recommend the next move for each.
